_README: Label id -> structure name for the upper-limb bone label volume of the Visible Human male: CT part from scripts/segment_arm_bones_vhm.py (HU threshold, marker watershed), extended through the colour cryosections by scripts/cryo/complete_arm_bones_from_cryo.py where the CT field of view clips the arms (elbow region), plus the reviewed mapping onto atlas entities.

A KEY, not data. Version 2 (2026-09-11): the humerus now runs to the elbow, the ulna to the olecranon, the radius to the radial head on the left; on the right the proximal radius (radial head/neck) is partly labelled as ulna. The elbow joint surfaces are placed by a luminance watershed between the bones' own regions plus an anatomical joint line estimated from the humeral head (about +-10 mm); treat the elbow as approximate. The hand is complete but unseparated (composite hand_r / hand_l).

Version 3 (2026-09-11): hand masses 4/8 replaced by the carpal/metacarpal/phalangeal groups 9-14 (labels 4/8 no longer occur); the fingers come from the top of the legs CT block (the torso block ends at the palm), carried over by the measured block offset.
source: U.S. National Library of Medicine, The Visible Human Project (public domain), series 5d409385-d3e7-48a9-ae50-150b39e834da via the NCI Imaging Data Commons mirror (Fedorov A et al., Radiographics 2023, doi:10.1148/rg.230180). Segmentation produced in this repository; radius/ulna identity by distal width (radius wider) confirmed by distal reach (radial styloid lower), both sides. Cryosection part: NLM Visible Human Project male colour cryosections (public domain), IDC series 4aaf9181-fb6a-4a4c-bf49-d1eb9ed4a385, registered to the CT (scripts/cryo/README.md).

humerus_right.note: TotalSegmentator humerus label, extended through the photographs to the elbow joint line; distal joint surface approximate (+-10 mm).

radius_right.note: CT part from the wrist; proximal end from the photographs. Right: radial head/neck partly taken by the ulna label -- known defect.

ulna_right.note: CT part from the wrist; proximal end (coronoid, olecranon) from the photographs; trochlear notch approximate.

humerus_left.note: TotalSegmentator humerus label, extended through the photographs to the elbow joint line; distal joint surface approximate (+-10 mm).

radius_left.note: CT part from the wrist; proximal end from the photographs. Left: reaches the radial head.

ulna_left.note: CT part from the wrist; proximal end (coronoid, olecranon) from the photographs; trochlear notch approximate.

carpals_right.note: Hand mass (torso CT block + fingers from the legs CT block) cut by planes along the hand axis: 0-45 mm from the radius end. Rule-based grouping, bones not separated.

metacarpals_right.note: 45-115 mm along the hand axis; the thumb metacarpal, which starts more proximally, is cut by the same planes.

phalanges_right.note: Beyond 115 mm along the hand axis.

carpals_left.note: Hand mass (torso CT block + fingers from the legs CT block) cut by planes along the hand axis: 0-45 mm from the radius end. Rule-based grouping, bones not separated.

metacarpals_left.note: 45-115 mm along the hand axis; the thumb metacarpal, which starts more proximally, is cut by the same planes.

phalanges_left.note: Beyond 115 mm along the hand axis.
